Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.persistence.mapper

Class ConversationMapper

java.lang.Object
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.ConversationMapper
public final class ConversationMapper extends Object
Translates between the Conversation / Message domain aggregates and the ConversationJpa / MessageJpa entities.

Owner translation is the load-bearing piece: the sealed ConversationOwner maps to the two mutually-exclusive owner columns via resolveUserRef(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.conversation.ConversationOwner) / resolveApiKeyRef(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.conversation.ConversationOwner), and the read path defensively asserts exactly one of the two is non-null (the ck_conversations_owner_xor check constraint guarantees this at the schema level — the assertion catches a regression where the constraint is dropped or where the entity is constructed in-memory in a test without going through the DB).

      public static ConversationJpa toJpa(Conversation domain, AgentJpa agentRef, UserJpa ownerUserRef, ApiKeyJpa ownerApiKeyRef)
      Builds a fresh ConversationJpa for save. The caller is expected to have already resolved the parent AgentJpa reference (via agentJpaRepository.getReferenceById) and exactly one of the UserJpa / ApiKeyJpa owner references depending on the domain owner type.

    • updateMutableFields

      public static void updateMutableFields(ConversationJpa jpa, Conversation domain)
      Updates an existing ConversationJpa in-place with the mutable fields of domain. Used by the save path when the row already exists, so we re-use the entity's JPA-managed state (including the owner column that does not change once persisted).
